fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Isolate the suspicious cell by blacklisting its CI/PCI/TAC in RAN.
Enable NAS security mode enforcement with mandatory integrity protection.
Deploy NAS trace analysis with threshold for repeated 126 cause values.
Configure core to reject NAS messages from unknown TAI lists.
Implement NAS replay attack detection with sequence number validation.
Set NAS timer T350 for registration attempts to 10 seconds max.
Enforce NAS security context validation for all attach requests.
Deploy 5G NAS authentication failure rate KPI monitoring.
Block NAS messages from cells with mismatched PLMN-ID.
Update RAN to enforce NAS security mode 1 for all attachments.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
Cross Check Between Application Layer And Transport Layer
